lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\EPCQRCodeGenerator\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.

boot() registers a listener or takes a service from the container in 2 places. boot() runs once for every process of the server, so each of them is built on every request. registerEventListener() in register() builds a listener only when its event fires.

Nothing in the app calls 3 OCS routes. OCS is there for clients outside the app, so this is no defect in itself.
GET /ocs/v2.php/apps/epc_qrcode_generator/api/v1/history  ocs.epc_qrcode_generator.api.listhistory  appinfo/routes.php:5 ocs
POST /ocs/v2.php/apps/epc_qrcode_generator/api/v1/history  ocs.epc_qrcode_generator.api.createhistory  appinfo/routes.php:5 ocs
POST /ocs/v2.php/apps/epc_qrcode_generator/api/v1/export/save  ocs.epc_qrcode_generator.api.savetofiles  appinfo/routes.php:5 ocs
The app has 3 OCS routes and no openapi.json. Clients of OCS are generated from such a specification, and nothing else tells them what these routes take and return.
